summary: 9 film announcements, 6 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Leprechaun
film.announcement: New horror film in development from Lionsgate with screenwriters Patrick Melton and Marcus Dunstan attached.

film.title: The Legend of Zelda
film.announcement: Lydia Peckham cast in the video game adaptation film.

film.title: Drifter
film.talent: Kate Beckinsale, Dermot Mulroney, Robert Knepper, Sticky Fingaz
film.announcement: Action-thriller film with Kate Beckinsale, Dermot Mulroney, Robert Knepper, and rapper Sticky Fingaz in lead roles.

film.title: The Gallerist
film.announcement: MRC comedy film starring Jenna Ortega and Natalie Portman acquired by Roadside Attractions and Vertical for U.S. distribution.

film.title: Nickels
film.announcement: Supernatural drama starring Rob Riggle set for fall theatrical and PVOD release by Briarcliff Entertainment.

film.title: Blur
film.announcement: Sci-fi action film in development at Netflix with director Kirill Sokolov, known for 'They Will Kill You,' attached.

film.title: Crawl
film.announcement: Sequel to 'Crawl' in development at Paramount with Mason Gooding and Emily Rudd starring.

film.title: Dedicated to Morris Burke
film.announcement: Indie dark comedy film starring Da'Vine Joy Randolph with director Will Ropp attached.

film.title: Descendants: Hidden Heroes
film.announcement: New Disney film expanding the Descendants universe, featuring children of sidekicks from 'Aladdin,' 'The Emperor's New Groove,' and other films.

tv.title: Sherlock's Secretary
tv.announcement: Procedural series in development at USA Network from 'Psych' creator Andy Berman.

tv.title: Heated Rivalry
tv.announcement: Season 2 casting announced with Justice Smith and Charlie Gillespie as Harris and Troy; Season 2 debut confirmed for Spring 2027.

tv.title: New York Yankees Drama Series
tv.talent: Jason Bateman (Aggregate Films), Josh Wakely, MLB
tv.announcement: Netflix is developing a drama series about the New York Yankees from Jason Bateman's production company Aggregate Films, Josh Wakely, and MLB.

tv.title: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives
tv.announcement: Reality series renewed for 20 additional episodes following Taylor Frankie Paul drama.

tv.title: Ted Lasso
tv.announcement: Season 4 is underway with women's sports as a key storyline that brought the hit show back.

tv.title: Baywatch
tv.announcement: Show honored 16-year-old lifeguard hero Ryder Williams during a set visit.
